column2: Set a limit for each category, and Dabbar alerts you
Pick a monthly limit for each category you spend on (food, entertainment, transport...), and we'll alert you as soon as you reach 80% of it, so you don't get surprised at month-end.
Set your goal, and Dabbar walks you there step by step
Want to save for a trip, a car, or any goal? Set it in Dabbar and it helps you organize your saving so you reach it on time.
A full report, daily and monthly
You can export a PDF report showing all your spending and income day by day or month by month, ready to review or share whenever you like.
All your alerts in one place

Turn on Dabbar notifications so your alerts reach your phone screen even when you're outside the app (budget alerts, daily and weekly summaries), link Telegram to get them instantly, and there's also an in-app notification center.
Save your money in Dabbar's piggy bank
Set aside any amount you want to save, and track it until it reaches the amount you want.
Who owes you, who you owe, and all your occasions
Record your debts (what you're owed and what you owe), your savings circles, and your occasions like weddings and engagements — all tracked in one place.
Stay ahead of your due dates
Dabbar reminds you of your installment dates and any commitment before it arrives, so nothing catches you off guard.
